title: Case-relative cassation workbench artifact contracts
description: Versioned, fail-closed exchange contracts for case-relative cassation research. A conforming document MUST match exactly one root artifact definition.

canonical_visible_identifier.x-runtime-invariant: NFKC-safe visible text with canonical whitespace; Cc, Cf, and Cs code points are rejected

x-runtime-invariants: the current builder always emits the closed coding_reliability_origin and exactly ten closed input_sha256s bindings; historical non-claim-ready profiles may remain structurally readable without the native fields but cannot pass current claim-use runtime validation
claim_use_ready=true requires coding_reliability_origin.status=native_finalization_bound, no origin reason codes, every origin verification boolean true, and coding reliability usable_for_claim=true

input_sha256s.coding_reliability binds the canonical reliability object, input_sha256s.coding_audit_finalization_receipt binds the complete receipt object, and input_sha256s.expected_finalization_receipt_sha256 exactly equals coding_reliability_origin.expected_receipt_sha256

runtime verification enforces the separately supplied expected_finalization_receipt_sha256, receipt self-digest, exactly-one-LF reliability file digest, audit-plan equality, and ordered candidate equality; JSON Schema alone cannot prove these relations
claim_use_ready records bounded technical lineage only and does not authenticate a person or establish legal correctness, current law, publication permission, approval, or filing readiness
audit_plan_sha256 is the canonical digest of the exact remaining fields
required_candidate_ids is exactly the disjoint union of substantive and false-exclusion samples
sample sizes equal their canonical unique ID lists and every screening-frame candidate has a primary decision
audited_candidate_ids must equal required_candidate_ids exactly and all diagnostic identifier arrays must be unique canonical visible strings
each disagreement candidate_id must be required, unique, and bound to the exact primary and secondary coding digests
each false_exclusion_diagnostic must be unique and match a label field disagreement for the same candidate_id
a complete result requires every disagreement resolved by a digest-bound independent human adjudication and every invalid or unresolved array empty
refresh_plan_sha256 and refresh_plan_id must bind the exact closed refresh plan
coverage_gaps must be an exact subset of declared coverage_requirements and their digest must match
plan, treatment set and live read-only cache must have identical corpus, treatment ID and population bindings
pending, verified, rejected and superseded treatment IDs must be pairwise disjoint and their union must equal the complete treatment population
complete=true requires an exact verified live binding, empty blocking diagnostics and valid chronology
receipt_sha256 is the canonical digest of the exact remaining receipt fields
coding_reliability_file_sha256 is SHA-256 of canonical sorted compact UTF-8 coding_reliability JSON with ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false, and exactly one trailing LF
audit_plan_sha256 must equal the reliability audit_plan_sha256 and candidate_ids must exactly equal reliability required_candidate_ids in order; runtime consumers revalidate both relations

the separately retained expected finalization receipt digest is carried only by the enclosing special handoff binding, must equal receipt_sha256, and must never be derived from the receipt being checked
schema validation is structural; receipt self-digest, full artifact digest, exact-file bytes, audit-plan equality, candidate order, and profile-origin links require runtime validation
a valid receipt proves bounded technical lineage only and does not authenticate a person or establish legal correctness, current law, publication permission, approval, or filing readiness
status is the effective quality status while review_decision is the immutable human decision
supersession is derived from the complete reciprocal single-successor graph
